epic.title: Live data and the AI researcher
epic.description: The provider-agnostic AI layer with the $5 cap, the search connector, the weekly researcher that publishes raids, Max Battles, events, eggs and research, and the live-data API.

features.title: AI provider layer and cost cap
tasks: Provider-agnostic AI interface in .NET with a Claude implementation
Cost tracking per call and per month; shared $5 cap that pauses AI and tells the admin

features.title: Search and fetch connector
tasks: Pluggable search / fetch interface; first provider chosen at build time
Fetch community pages (e.g. LeekDuck) with rate limits and caching

features.title: Weekly AI researcher
tasks: Research prompts and tools: raids, Max Battles, events, egg pools, research tasks
Structured output validated against the Pokédex (unknown Pokémon rejected)
Publish automatically with source links; detect new and changed entries
Never overwrite admin-fixed entries; flag 'source changed since your fix'
Run log and cost per run
Recorded-response tests: replay saved pages so tests don't call the AI

features.title: Live data API
tasks: Endpoints: raids now / next, Max Battles, events by day, egg pools, research
100% CPs for raid catches (L20 / L25), eggs (L20) and research (L15)
